contracts_rationale: Internal consolidation: no interface, endpoint, event payload or file format changes. The only contract is the anchored lock path itself, pinned by value in tests/kernel/test_lock_paths.py and documented in data-model.md.
friendly_name: One kernel helper for anchor-keyed lock paths
purpose_context: The event-log, charter synthesis and Mission status lock families each re-derive the anchor-keyed lock path with their own copy of the digest and common-dir logic (#6727). Route all three through one kernel helper with byte-identical lock names.
purpose_tldr: Extract one kernel helper for anchor-keyed lock paths
